ex.title: United States v. Angelos, Tenth Circuit, 2006
ex.sub: Three counts under § 924(c) in one case: a mandatory 55 years in prison. Which words did the court apply, and do they still say it?
ex.then: “In the case of a second or subsequent conviction under this subsection, the person shall— (i) be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 25 years”
ex.now: “In the case of a violation of this subsection that occurs after a prior conviction under this subsection has become final, the person shall— (i) be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 25 years”
ex.res: Changed by the First Step Act of 2018. Counts charged together no longer stack; the change did not reach sentences already imposed.
